UDP::mss
Description
Returns the on-wire Maximum Segment Size (MSS) for a UDP connection.
Syntax
UDP
::
mss
UDP::mss
Returns the on-wire Maximum Segment Size (MSS) for a UDP connection.
Examples
when
CLIENT_ACCEPTED
{
if
{
[
UDP
::
mss
]
<
1000
}
{
pool
small_req_pool
}
else
{
pool
large_req_pool
}
}
